app_tagline: Turn your iPhone into a phone that leaves you alone.
gen_supervised_note: This profile only installs on a supervised iPhone. On a normal iPhone, iOS stops it with: "Profile Installation Failed. Unsupervised devices require a ContentFilterUUID in the content filter payload." Nothing gets installed and nothing breaks.
gen_identifier_help: Reverse-domain, like com.example.dumbphone. Reinstalling with the same identifier updates the profile in place.
gen_identifier_error: Use a reverse-domain identifier, like com.example.dumbphone.
gen_app_search_error: The App Store search did not answer. Try again in a moment.
gen_apps_empty: No apps blocked yet. Search above to add some.
gen_web_private_browsing: Allow private tabs and clearing history
gen_allow_app_store_help: Turning it off also stops app updates; banks and airlines break. Blocking apps by name is usually better.
gen_lock_removal: Lock the profile so it cannot be removed
gen_install_step_transfer: AirDrop or email the file to the iPhone.
gen_install_step_settings: Open Settings, then Profile Downloaded, then Install.
gen_install_step_reboot: Reboot if a blocked app icon lingers.
gen_install_step_unsupervised: If you see "Unsupervised devices require a ContentFilterUUID", the iPhone is not supervised yet. Follow the supervision guide first, then install again.
gen_install_note: Blocked apps still download from the App Store, but they stay hidden and will not open.
auth_login_description: Welcome back. Enter your credentials to continue.
auth_signup_description: Create your account in a few seconds.
error_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error_user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
error_unauthorized: You need to log in to do that.
error_invalid_input: Something in the form is not right. Check the fields and try again.
error_not_found: We could not find what you were looking for.
error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
